patch_description: This approach replaces the broad archive-neighborhood search with a two-part exploration strategy. It first scores a diverse set of repaired QAOA samples, then repeatedly chooses two scored networks and path-relinks between them by adding edges from one guide network while preserving degree constraints with valid two-switches. When relinking stalls, it uses bottleneck information from `lp_detail` to propose targeted switches, with occasional more disruptive switches to escape local structure. Candidate moves are screened using the pool’s energy surrogate and topology diversity before spending LP calls. A small annealed acceptance rule lets the search move between regions rather than relying only on improving parents.
